title: "invalid_phased_state"
description: "The persisted state of an actor with states is not `{ shared, phase, locals, stateTimers }`."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** The persisted state of an actor with states is not `{ shared, phase, locals, stateTimers }`.

**How to fix it:** Do not write the persisted state by hand; restore or migrate through `versions`.

Thrown as an `ActorKitError` (or a subclass) whose `code` is this one and whose `docs` is this page.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
